results.title: Police to keep assisting fallen seniors outside working hours
results.description: The Ministry of the Interior has changed its initial decision, under which police officers would no longer have to go help elderly people who have fallen at home, leaving this to ambulance crews and social workers, and has now announced that it will temporarily continue providing this assistance outside working hours.

results.title: World grasped out nuclear club was nothing more than a lie
results.description: TEHRAN, Sep. 05 (MNA) – Emphasizing that the world has realized that the nuclear club was nothing more than a lie, Iran’s First Vice President Mohammadreza Aref stated that Iran’s strategy is a strategy that stems from the Revolution and its people.

results.title: Pakistan will remain major security concern, threat for times to come: ex-CDS Gen Anil Chauhan
results.description: Former CDS Gen Anil Chauhan has raised concerns regarding Pakistan's possible overconfidence stemming from new defense agreements. He emphasized that Pakistan continues to pose a serious security threat to India. Strategies like Operation Sindoor are part of India's efforts to drive behavioral changes in Pakistan. The stability-instability paradox underpins Pakistan's reliance on proxy warfare and terrorism, necessitating India to uphold strong deterrence across all fronts to thwart these dangers.
